sentence: This project builds methods that use data to measure how uncertain computer models of storm surge and flooding from hurricanes are.
This project builds an open cloud-based platform that sets up Capture The Flag contests about network security.
This project builds an optical waveguide that delivers light to chosen layers of the brain and works with MRI scanning.
This project studies how community service internships change attitudes about social justice and service-learning, and academic performance, over time.
This project adds artificial intelligence and machine learning to biology courses and research, using authentic biological datasets from genomics and immunology.
This project tries to find out whether sodium and potassium channels gather in the wider parts of unmyelinated axons because of membrane shape.
This project builds a cloud-native data repository that helps researchers share, discover and reuse environmental data.
This project studies how the RNA genomes of bacteriophages fold into shapes that coat proteins recognize and package into protein shells.
This project builds ways to find, explain and reduce timing and control attacks on open radio access networks using artificial intelligence.
This project tries to find out which genes build the flower head of sunflowers, daisies and their relatives by comparing genomes.
This project builds methods that measure the speed of individual ribosomes making proteins in live cells.
This project studies how adhesive forces between particles in a liquid control how cohesive granular materials flow.
This project builds a deep learning model that detects and measures emissions from oil and gas sites in satellite images.
This project studies how to make smart fabrics from nano-sized piezoelectric polymer yarns and combine them with conventional fabrics.
This project builds low-cost tactile displays that let people who are blind or visually impaired understand and create 3D models.
This project applies natural language processing to text data to help researchers understand learning.
